changes: Rich compose toolbar uses native HTML/plain MIME alternatives and the existing draft/send APIs.
Font, size, emphasis, color/highlight, alignment, lists, indent, quote, strike, clear-format, undo/redo and validated link insertion/editing.
Safe HTML message rendering, HTML signatures, plain-text preference persistence and sanitized paste.
Binary and filename-free CID attachments survive draft rebuild; CID images render in compose and sent messages.
Inline images keep their MIME references when browser formatting clones editor nodes.

validation.browser: Google Chrome through CUA and the sample BrowserProxy
flows: Existing API draft opens with HTML and binary attachment
Italic formatting and close/reopen preserve rich content
Invalid link URL rejected; valid URL inserted; existing link destination restored; cancel preserves content
Send/readback retains rich HTML, Unicode and binary attachment
Formatted send-as signature loads on new compose
Plain-text mode strips HTML and persists across reload/reopen
Mobile font/size/alignment/underline, list, indent/outdent, strike, undo/redo, color/highlight and quote controls
Mobile rich draft save/reload/send and protected native-state readback
Filename-free inline image loads from native attachment data in editor and sent message
Repeated clone-producing list/indent/undo/redo flow retains original CID in native MIME

limits: CI, production deployment and fresh hosted validation pending.
Official formatting help and local desktop/mobile inspection inform this implementation; exhaustive provider visual comparison remains open.
Full compose menus/Drive picker, account/admin/AI, filter delivery and full eight-twin parity remain outside this change.

review_fixes.remote_images: No request on reader open or draft open/save. One controlled localhost image request follows the explicit display action; URL retained in native MIME.
review_fixes.inline_fallback: Referenced raster hides its card only after successful load; unsupported SVG and unreferenced inline file retain visible download controls.
